title: Analyze bounded feedback
scope: One bounded P-control integrator step, not general PID

items.prompt: Toy integrator y_next=y+0.1u. P control u=clip(2(r−y),−1.5,1.5), y=0.5,r=2. Compute applied u and next y.
items.solution: The raw command is 3, clipped to 1.5; next y=13/20. Saturation changes the closed-loop behavior.

items.solution: Compute error r−y before clipping. The actuator clips the control input, not the state: u=-2, y_next=5.8.
